neighbours.label: ' in' of 'follow in his steps' and other New Testament exhortation
fire: Christ died for you and calls you to follow in his steps.
He left us an example, that we should follow in his steps.
Jesus suffered for us, and we are to walk in his steps.
Believers are called to follow in the steps of the Lord.
He expects you to follow in his steps every day.
Peter tells us to follow in the footsteps of Christ.
The great test for Nicodemus was to come by day.
Disciples must walk in his way and take up the cross.
quiet: The doctor came for you and asks you to wait in the hall.
He left us a note, saying that we should wait in the car.
The team lost to us, and we are going to the next round.
Tourists are asked to walk on the path by the lake.
He expects you to clean the kitchen every day.
Peter tells us to bring our boots for the hike.
The great test for the team was to come on Friday.
Hikers must walk on the trail and carry water.
